name: in_view_opens_first_click
spec_quote: It clicks the button and waits for the entry form's first box (the Institution input). It returns True when the box became visible, False otherwise.

name: in_view_opens_second_click
spec_quote: It clicks at most twice (one more click when the first did not open the form)

name: in_view_third_click_too_many
spec_quote: It clicks at most twice (one more click when the first did not open the form)

name: in_view_never_opens
spec_quote: when the form never opens it returns False

name: far_below_opens_first_click
spec_quote: may be anywhere on a long page, including far below the visible window

name: far_below_third_click_too_many
spec_quote: It clicks at most twice (one more click when the first did not open the form)

name: far_below_never_opens

name: no_button_on_page

name: hidden_button_in_view
spec_quote: A button that is hidden (zero size) counts as not existing.

name: hidden_button_far_below

name: button_at_top_edge_opens_second_click
